owner: PMICE (Ministry of Telecommunications/Government of Chad); delivery contractor Huawei; supervision Gulf/GOLF Consultancy; audit-certification partner TECHSO-GROUP with ADETIC/ANSICE
notes: Chad's sovereign National Data Center in N'Djamena (2020 PMICE plan: 2,000 m2 three-storey building). Status per 2026 sources: building completed and digital equipment installed; 5 Feb 2026 tripartite accord (ADETIC/ANSICE/TECHSO-GROUP) for audit and certification of building/equipment - ADETIC DG calls it 'the last stage before the inauguration'; ANSICE conducted a guided visit; Huawei guided the audit visit (ADETIC 12 Feb 2026 article). PMICE Phase I provisional reception acted at Sarh 20 Dec 2025 covers the DC component per ministry. World Bank P180000 (A) confirms PMICE (EXIMBANK US$180m) builds 1,200 km fiber, a Data Center and its national backup, and 200 mobile sites. Per methodology: not officially operational until an A-grade commissioning/inauguration source appears. Capacity (MW/racks) not published; exact address/arrondissement not published.
